### 1 — Scene
A breakfast of fried egg, toast, avocado, a small bowl of orange-colored fruit (likely peaches), and coffee with milk/foam.

### 2 — Vessels
- **Main plate:** approximately 22 cm diameter; area = 3.14 × 11² = **380 cm²**.
- **Fruit bowl:** approximately 9 cm diameter; area ≈ **64 cm²**.
- **Coffee mug:** approximately 7.5 cm internal diameter; area ≈ **44 cm²**.

### 3–7 — Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy
The toast appears to comprise two overlapping slices. No separate pool of oil or sauce is visible; estimated cooking fat is included in the toast and egg energy densities.

| Item | Vessel area covered | Area × average height = gross volume | Density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Toast, lightly buttered/oiled | 30% of plate | 114 × 1.8 = 205 ml | 0.30 | 62 g | 300 | 186 kcal |
| Fried egg | 22% of plate | 84 × 0.65 = 55 ml | 1.00 | 55 g | 195 | 107 kcal |
| Avocado | 15% of plate | 57 × 0.9 = 51 ml | 0.95 | 49 g | 160 | 78 kcal |
| Peach-like fruit pieces | 60% of bowl | 38 × 2.8 = 106 ml | 0.60 | 64 g | 60 | 38 kcal |
| Coffee with milk/foam | 100% of mug interior | 44 × 6 = 264 ml | 0.95 | 251 g | 30 | 75 kcal |

**Coverage check:** Main-plate items cover approximately **67%** of its area, consistent with the visible empty portions. Fruit and coffee use their own vessel areas.

### 8 — Sanity check
The solid food totals approximately **230 g and 409 kcal**, plausible for the visible egg, toast, avocado, and small fruit portion. Including the drink gives approximately **481 g and 484 kcal**. Milk quantity and fat on the toast are the largest energy uncertainties.
